up: List the canonical SMILES for molecules that have been tested against human histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.pref_name = 'Histone deacetylase 6' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
